evidence.text: Rain drops falling from a cloud 帀
Pictograph of rain falling from a cloud.
水从雲下也。一象天，冂象雲，水霝其閒也。凡雨之屬皆从雨。

Pictogram (象形) – a cloud with drops of rain falling from it. The horizontal stroke at the top was added later. (Compare Egyptian 𓇲.)
From Proto-Sino-Tibetan *rV-waʔ.
